description: Pregunta por comando `npm ci` vs `npm install` respecto a modificación del lockfile.

at.need: Does npm ci ever update or modify package-lock.json?
fragments: npm install automatically updates package-lock.json if dependencies in package.json changed.
No: npm ci strictly installs from package-lock.json and never writes to it; if package.json and package-lock.json are out of sync, npm ci throws an error and exits.

description: Distinción entre `Promise.all` y `Promise.allSettled` cuando una promesa rechaza.

at.need: How does Promise.allSettled differ from Promise.all when one input promise rejects?
fragments: Promise.all short-circuits and immediately rejects as soon as any input promise rejects.
Promise.allSettled waits for every promise to finish (fulfilled or rejected) and resolves to an array of outcome objects with status and value or reason.
Promise.race settles with the first settled promise.

description: Menciona `robots.txt` pero la pregunta es sobre `llms.txt` o `sitemap.xml` para indexación.

at.need: Where do websites list canonical URLs for search engine crawlers in XML format?
fragments: robots.txt instructs web crawlers which URL paths they may or may not crawl using Allow and Disallow rules.
sitemap.xml (Sitemaps protocol) lists canonical URLs with optional lastmod timestamps and priorities for search engine indexing.
